research.name: ratatui-hypertile
research.note: Hyprland-style BSP tiling for Ratatui apps, with animated pane moves, mouse-dragged split borders and a plugin palette.

effects: Hyprland-style BSP pane tiling inside a single Ratatui app
panes glide between tiles when moved, shown mid-transition in the recording
split borders resized by hovering and dragging with the mouse
command palette that fuzzy-picks a plugin to fill a newly split pane
